Nora Fontaine
nora.fontaine@example.com | Detroit, MI
Nora Fontaine has 9 years of experience in backend and distributed systems.
Most recently, Staff Backend Engineer at Beacon Platform (2023-2026), where
they introduced Terraform-managed infrastructure, cutting provisioning time by
70%. Before that, Senior Backend Engineer at Quartzline Infrastructure
(2017-2023). Education: M.S. Computer Engineering, Metro State University,
2016; B.S. Computer Engineering, Drexel University, 2013. Core skills:
PostgreSQL, Distributed systems, Node.js.
